events.title: Griffith's Valuation
events.text:
Named as occupiers in 3 townlands:
Clogher: Phelim Gildea.
Cullionboy: Jeremiah Gildea; Patrick Gildea.
Druminnin: Edward Gildea; Jeremiah Gildea; Patrick Gildea; Phelim Gildea.

association.label: The occupier surname is written to match the family.
